title: PilotTrace
description:
PilotTrace is an illustrative, offline Python prototype for validating and deterministically scoring caller-mapped numeric trace data. Each accepted frame contains exactly 512 finite numeric values, partitioned into sixteen contiguous blocks of 32 values. Each block is scored as 0.45 * max(abs(x)) + 0.35 * RMS(x) + 0.20 * mean(abs(x)); a block is flagged when its score is greater than or equal to the finite, non-negative threshold frozen in the manifest.

The report preserves rejected-frame indices and reasons, exact-input SHA-256 hashes, all block scores, flagged blocks, and descriptive frame-classification metrics only for accepted frames carrying supplied boolean labels. The implementation uses only the Python standard library and has no external connections.

Scope and limits. This is research software for offline schema and deterministic-arithmetic demonstration. It does not establish compatibility with external equipment or telemetry, and is not validated operational detection, an alarm, safety system, medical device, or process-control system. Examples and tests are SYNTHETIC; no empirical, field, hardware, or clinical performance is claimed.
